|errata_history=Versions of [[Aurra Sing (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. * '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing (V) (Virtual Set 12)]]): the release sheet “Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates” (Players Committee, “Official text as of January 9, 2007”; PDF dated 10 January 2007; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007), page 4, slip 24 ([[:File:OVS12-24-Aurra_Sing-slip-2007-01-09.png]]), in the Committee's Remaster template; game text as above.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the re-issued sheet (PDF dated 12 August 2008; headed “Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 20 February 2009), page 4, slip 24 ([[:File:OVS12-24-Aurra_Sing-slip-2008-08-12.png]]). '''What changed:''' the words and numbers are unchanged; the credit line, printed in January 2007 sideways in the slip's side margins (“Original concept” / “by Sam Tashima” / “States” / “2006” / “Dakota” / “North”), now runs along the bottom of the text box as one line: “Original concept by Sam Tashima     North Dakota States 2006”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
